The abolition of border checks is accompanied by various compensatory measures involving extensive cooperation. Czechia fully joined the Schengen Area at the end of 2007. Czechia is a part of the Schengen Area, i.e., a group of countries that carry out no checks at their common borders and that have brought their efforts to fulfill the right of free movement of persons to fruition.
